methodology.ranking_amount: recorded_judgment_amount from the extractor-selected explicit total judgment event
methodology.eligibility: positive total, selected event hash present, review_required=false, judgment_is_vacated=false
methodology.components: reported principal, interest, costs, attorney fees, reimbursement, sanctions, damages, and restoration are displayed when extracted but never summed into the ranked total because they may be included in or overlap that total
methodology.satisfaction: a satisfaction is asserted only from an operative whole-judgment satisfaction event after the selected judgment; otherwise the label is no current full satisfaction recorded, which does not assert nonpayment; satisfied judgments remain historical judgments and are not subtracted or counted again
methodology.attorney_attribution: role-neutral accepted California attorney associations are linked; additional unresolved attorney names copied from court representation records are display-only and never affect attorney rankings; neither is an assertion that counsel obtained or opposed the judgment
methodology.sort: judgment_amount descending, case_number ascending; competition ranks for ties
methodology.publication: all eligible judgments are published in rank-ordered shards; the manifest contains a small bootstrap for fast viewer startup
